meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

copy.tagline: 用CLI创建、预览和渲染超帧动画与视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要开发超帧动画并用命令行管理渲染
copy.tagline_en: Create, preview, and render hyperframe animations and videos using the CLI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop hyperframe animations and manage rendering from the command line

howto.what: Claude 现在可以使用 HyperFrames CLI 命令来管理视频项目的全流程：创建项目、编写脚本、检查错误、预览效果、渲染视频，以及部署到云端等。也能诊断构建或渲染失败的问题。
howto.when: 当用户要求使用 HyperFrames 框架创建、检查、预览或渲染视频项目，或者诊断构建/渲染失败时，Claude 会调用 HyperFrames CLI 命令来完成这些任务。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes 初始化一个新项目，命名为 'demo'。
say.note: 执行 npx hyperframes init demo。

say.text: 检查当前 hyperframes 项目的 lint 错误。
预览我的 hyperframes 项目，然后问我是否渲染。

howto.what_en: Claude can now use HyperFrames CLI commands to manage the full video project workflow: create projects, author scripts, check for errors, preview results, render videos, and deploy to the cloud. It can also diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: When the user requests to create, check, preview, or render a video project using the HyperFrames framework, or diagnose build/render failures, Claude invokes the appropriate HyperFrames CLI commands.

say_en.text: Initialize a new HyperFrames project named 'demo'.
Lint the current HyperFrames project for errors.
Preview my HyperFrames project, then ask if I want to render.
say_en.note: Runs npx hyperframes preview and waits for approval.
